text:
maria: quick check — where are the saved log queries for model/route/region? doing a canary rollout for model 'zenith' in ap-sg, want to attach a few saved searches for 5xx, kv-cache misses, and p95 latency to the PR/docs. any pointers or dashboards?

sam: put a few in the ops saved library yesterday. main ones: zenith-error-stream (5xx), zenith-kv-miss-rate, zenith-p95-latency. dashboards: zenith-overview (grafana) and inference-ops-summary. links below.

sam: query snippets you can paste into logsearch: 
```
service:inference route:zenith model:zenith-* region:ap-sg (status:5xx OR kv_cache:miss=true)
| timeslice 1m
| stats p95(latency_ms) as p95_latency, count() as errors, sum(if(kv_cache="miss",1,0)) as kv_miss by timeslice
```

sam: saved search paths: /ops/saved/zenith-error-stream, /ops/saved/zenith-kv-miss-rate, /ops/saved/zenith-p95-latency. Grafana links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/zenith-overview?orgId=1&var-region=ap-sg and https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ef01/inference-ops-summary

jin: for alerting, I recommend separating 5xx alerts from kv-miss trend alerts. Example alert rule (LogAlert):
```
query: service:inference route:zenith region:ap-sg status:5xx | count()
condition: count() > 50 for 5m
```
and for kv miss regression:
```
query: service:inference route:zenith region:ap-sg kv_cache:miss=true | rate()
condition: increase(rate, last_5m) > 0.005 (0.5%)
```
keep the kv alert as a low-severity pager initially, notify #eng-sre and the canary channel.

alex: thanks — how do I save one of these as a persistent saved view? I only see ad-hoc search results right now.

sam: open logsearch, paste query, then 'Save view' (top right). pick folder -> ops/saved -> give it a short name (we use zenith-<metric>-<region>). check 'share with org' for team visibility. I'll create the three canonical ones if you prefer and share links in the PR.

leo: can someone drop baseline p95 numbers for zenith in ap-sg so I can compare the canary? need last 24h.
sam: baseline (24h): p95 ~ 210ms, kv_miss_rate ~ 0.9%, 5xx ~ 0.02% (low volume). I'll attach a screenshot to the PR.

maria: perfect, can you add the saved view links to my canary PR and create the two alert rules as low severity? i'll iterate on thresholds after we see traffic. thanks! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-notice: canary deploy zenith v2.1 started by @maria at 2147001155. See CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/6789

sam: done — created saved views and added links in the PR comments. created draft alerts in the staging alerting namespace, tags: canary, zenith, ap-sg.

maria: awesome, monitoring now. ping if anything noisy.

jin: if we see kv miss spike, recommend temporarily increasing cache TTL or fallback to quantized-small model for the canary traffic.

alex: noted, thanks everyone.
